scope: Independent read-only review of 36 network/background native PNGs plus binary/decode validation of all 90 curated PNGs.

dataIntegrity.method: Pillow verify() then reopen load() for each original PNG; size/bytes/SHA256/native HTML raw bytes matched. Only in-memory pixel reads, no raster writes or re-encoding.

limits: Static PNGs do not prove prototype targets, retries, return behavior, dynamic transition timing, or scroll reachability.
This report reviews only network/background visual pixels; other PNGs received full decode/dimension/hash validation but no visual sign-off here.
Overlay root exports show their own scrim/sheet content; absence of underlying source page in an isolated PNG is not a navigation failure conclusion.
